channel.title: Oberlin 3-2 Engineering Society
channel.description: Confirmed news and project updates from the society.

item.title: The society is entering its founding stage
item.description: Membership interest, leadership interest, and project proposals are now being collected.
item.content:encoded: The public website has been rebuilt around the society’s actual stage. Four project briefs are proposals, the first event is still being scheduled, leadership vacancies are shown as open, and the resource library points to original sources. The next step is to recruit the founding group and confirm the first meeting.

item.title: Founding members will choose the first project
item.description: Four project briefs are published as proposals, not active teams.
item.content:encoded: Interest is now being collected. A project will move to active status only after a lead, team, scope, meeting time, safety check, and first milestone are confirmed.
